summary: Prestwick radar service has reduced aircraft flow rate due to a single air traffic controller, 2200-0700.
text:
PRESTWICK RADAR OPR REDUCED FLOW RATE DUE ATC SINGLE CONTROLLER. 
ACFT WISHING TO USE PRESTWICK AS AN ALTN MAY EXPERIENCE DELAYS. ALL 
ACFT INBD TO PRESTWICK ARE TO MONITOR 121.5MHZ.
